correctness.rationale: The marked exponentials and censor atom exhaust the record. Each positive-length labelled density identifies slope and intercept even at equal rates; any zero-information tangent must annihilate both the constant and linear coefficients in both event scores and is zero. In intensity coordinates a_j=p_j lambda_j, the nuisance block is B diag(1/a_j)+O(B^2), the cross vector has entries -v_j B^2/2+O(B^3), and the target information starts at (B^3/3) sum a_j v_j^2, with v_j the p derivatives at fixed intensities. The censor atom contributes at order B^4 to the last block. Projection gives 1/3-1/4=1/12. Independent replay in the original rate coordinates recovered the same coefficient, with Fisher ratios 1.00300, 1.00040 and 1.00350 at B=.001 for the three frozen cases. Known-rate scores give the linear coefficient; at large B the event integrals converge by exponential tails and the censor contribution is bounded by a polynomial in B times an exponentially decaying probability, so complete-data orthogonality applies. The matched-intensity root-density difference is linear in t and integrates to the stated B^3/12 constant; the squared atom difference is O(B^4). Independent integration gave ratios .99759 and .99879 at B=.001. Tensorized affinity gives a positive lower bound along any bounded-MB^3 subsequence, and fixed MB makes total variation tend to zero. The theorem is a necessary bound on consistent discrimination, not literal nonidentifiability at any positive B or an estimator guarantee. Frozen checker was inspected, not executed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: A general likelihood or Fisher matrix at a fixed horizon is not a bound with a shrinking horizon: one must resolve the leading singular direction and the order lost to nuisance projection. originality.rationale: Best of examined literature. The motivating paper gives precisely this marked likelihood and warns that heavily censoring unknown rates impedes estimation. The singular efficient-information coefficient and tested fixed-intensity alternatives quantify, rather than rename, that warning. No earlier covering theorem was found in the inspected material.
residual_risks: Full competing-risks articles were not accessible for an appendix-level comparison; an analogous singular efficient-information calculation may be present in older or unindexed material.
The originality comparison is about the sharp quantitative limits for this experiment, not mixture modelling, censoring likelihoods or the affinity testing method.

value.rationale: Resolves a concrete observability question raised for trajectory filtering: estimating outcome proportions with uncalibrated durations costs two additional powers of short observation time, even when one retains exact times and labels. The matched-pair result shows that this is not merely a large standard error of one estimator; at a fixed total allocation some distinct models become indistinguishable. The advantages are specific to the posited parametric experiment.
